 Siddharth 
 10 November 2026 
 Samsung Android Rumors 
 Earlier today, dummy units of Apple’s iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18 surfaced online. Now, a new leak has given us a look at dummy models of Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S27 series.
 Prominent tipster Sonny Dickson has shared an image showing the dummy units of the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra , Galaxy S27 Pro, and Galaxy S27+.
 In the image, the Galaxy S27 Ultra and Galaxy S27 Pro are seen with the redesigned rear camera module previously seen in leaked renders . It stretches across the upper portion of the rear panel and houses two protruding camera lenses, alongside two additional cutouts that sit flush with the camera island.
 Meanwhile, the Galaxy S27+ appears to retain the same design as the current Galaxy S26+ . It features a pill-shaped camera module with three cutouts for the rear sensors, while the LED flash remains outside the module in the same position as on its predecessor.
 The Galaxy S27 Ultra is tipped to feature the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, while the Galaxy S27 Pro is expected to use the standard Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC.
 Meanwhile, the Galaxy S27+ is reportedly set to feature Samsung's in-house Exynos 2700 chipset, at least in Europe.
